high_level_description: The image depicts a person standing on a set of stone steps outdoors. The individual is wearing a black bikini with a tie at the front of the top. They have long hair that falls over their shoulders and are barefoot. The person appears to be posing for the photo, with one hand resting on their hip and the other touching their head. The setting is a tropical or subtropical environment, as indicated by the presence of palm trees and lush greenery in the background. There are also vibrant red flowers adding a pop of color to the scene.
